probes.name: duplicate-greater
probes.source:
Function Probe() As String
Dim f As Object
On Error GoTo Failed
Range("A1").NumberFormat="@"
Range("A1").Value=">0"
Range("A2").Value=1
Range("A3").Value=2
Set f=Range("A1:A3").FormatConditions.AddUniqueValues
f.DupeUnique=1
f.Font.Bold=True
Application.CalculateFull
Probe=Bits(Range("A1:A3"))
Exit Function
Failed:
Probe="ERR:" & CStr(Err.Number)
End Function
Function Bits(r As Range) As String
Dim c As Range
For Each c In r.Cells
If c.DisplayFormat.Font.Bold Then
Bits=Bits & "1"
Else
Bits=Bits & "0"
End If
Next
End Function
